skill.name: seo-authority-builder
skill.description: Audits content for E-E-A-T signals and recommends credibility, trust, citation, schema, and topical authority improvements.
skill.summary: Creates E-E-A-T audits and practical SEO authority improvement plans.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: All three static findings are false positives. The backticks are Markdown formatting, and the fact-checking text is a trust checklist item, not network reconnaissance.

static_findings.snippet: - If detailed examples are required, open `resources/implementation-playbook.md`.

finding_verdicts.reason: Line 25 contains a Markdown inline-code path to a resource file. It does not execute a shell command or ask the agent to run external commands.
Lines 84-94 are a fenced Markdown example showing the expected E-E-A-T output format. The triple backticks are formatting only, not Ruby or shell execution.
Lines 118-119 list fact-checking and correction processes as trust signals. There is no instruction to scan networks, probe hosts, or collect network data.

content.user_title: Build SEO Authority With E-E-A-T Audits
content.value_statement: SEO content often lacks clear experience, expertise, authority, and trust signals. This skill reviews pages and creates practical E-E-A-T improvement plans.
actual_capabilities: Reviews content for experience, expertise, authority, and trust signals.
Identifies missing author credentials, trust elements, citations, and social proof.
Produces an E-E-A-T scorecard and prioritized enhancement plan.
Recommends author bios, trust checklists, topical maps, and citation strategies.
Suggests schema markup and platform-specific implementation ideas.
limitations: It does not independently verify facts unless sources are provided.
It does not replace legal, medical, or financial expert review.
It does not guarantee search ranking improvements.
It needs content, audience, and site context for precise recommendations.

use_cases.title: Audit Article Credibility
use_cases.description: Review a draft or live page for authority gaps before publication.

use_cases.title: Build Client SEO Roadmaps
use_cases.description: Turn E-E-A-T gaps into prioritized actions for content and site teams.

use_cases.title: Improve YMYL Trust Signals
use_cases.description: Strengthen author, sourcing, correction, and transparency signals on sensitive pages.

prompt_templates.title: Audit a Page for E-E-A-T
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this page for experience, expertise, authority, and trust signals. Score each area and list the top five improvements. Content: [paste content].

prompt_templates.title: Improve Author Credibility
prompt_templates.scenario: Focused review of author and expert signals.
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze the author and contributor signals for this content. Suggest bio updates, credentials, citations, and review steps. Topic: [topic]. Content: [paste content].

prompt_templates.title: Build a Topical Authority Plan
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate planning across a content cluster.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a topical authority plan for [subject]. Include pillar pages, supporting articles, internal links, citation needs, and trust signals for each topic.

prompt_templates.title: Design a YMYL Trust Roadmap
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this YMYL content program for trust and authority. Prioritize risks, expert review needs, transparency pages, update policies, and schema opportunities.

output_examples.input: A finance guide with no author bio or citation section.
output: Add a credentialed author bio, reviewer details, source list, and update date.

output_examples.input: A health article cluster with thin internal linking.
output: Create a pillar page for the main condition topic.
Add supporting pages for symptoms, treatment options, prevention, and questions.
Link each page to medically reviewed sources and correction policies.

output_examples.input: A service page that needs stronger trust signals.
output: Add testimonials, certifications, team credentials, and contact details.
Include Organization schema and clear editorial ownership.
Move proof points near conversion sections.

best_practices: Provide page content, audience, topic, and current trust assets.
Ask for prioritized actions with evidence and owner roles.
Review YMYL recommendations with qualified subject matter experts.
anti_patterns: Asking it to invent credentials, reviews, or certifications.
Treating checklist completion as a ranking guarantee.
Publishing YMYL recommendations without expert review.

faq.question: What does this skill analyze?
faq.answer: It analyzes content for experience, expertise, authority, trust, citations, transparency, and topical depth.

faq.question: Can it improve YMYL content?
faq.answer: Yes. It can identify trust gaps, but qualified experts should review sensitive topics.

faq.question: Does it guarantee better rankings?
faq.answer: No. It improves quality signals, but search performance depends on many factors.

faq.question: What inputs work best?
faq.answer: Provide the page content, topic, target audience, author details, citations, and business context.

faq.question: Can it create author bio suggestions?
faq.answer: Yes. It can suggest bio structure, credential placement, review notes, and trust details.

faq.question: Which tools support this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
